structures.name: Hippocampus
structures.about: Its name means "sea horse" in Greek. It is involved in declarative memory formation and spatial memory.

structures.name: Pineal Body
structures.about: The small midline gland on the roof of the diencephalon, just rostral to the superior colliculi. It secretes melatonin and tracks the light cycle.

structures.name: Lateral Geniculate Nucleus
structures.about: The thalamic relay for vision. Fibers of the optic tract end here, and its output goes on to the primary visual cortex.

structures.name: Cerebral Aqueduct
structures.about: The narrow channel through the midbrain connecting the third and fourth ventricles.

structures.name: Medial Geniculate Nucleus
structures.about: The thalamic relay for hearing, receiving from the inferior colliculus and projecting to the auditory cortex.

structures.name: Cerebral Peduncles
structures.about: The paired columns of descending fibers on the ventral midbrain carrying motor output toward the brainstem and cord.
